marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to southeast 15 knots late this evening
and to southeast 20 after midnight. Wind increasing to southeast 30 early Friday
afternoon and to southeast 35 Friday evening. Snow and blowing snow Friday evening. Visibility 1 mile or
less in blowing snow. Temperatures near minus 3. <br/>

morning.<br/>
